study_identification_part.si_4_title: Neurodevelopmental model of schizophrenia revisited: similarity in individual deviation and idiosyncrasy from the normative model of whole-brain white matter tracts and shared brain-cognition covariation with ADHD and ASD

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: All participants (626 TDCs, 281 schizophrenia, 175 ASD, 279 ADHD) were recruited from and scanned at a single site: National Taiwan University Hospital, Taipei, Taiwan, using the same 3-Tesla Siemens TIM Trio scanner. The normative model was constructed from 626 typically developing controls (TDCs) from this cohort.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The three patient groups were recruited from the Department of Psychiatry, National Taiwan University Hospital. ... We recruited TDC from the same community of the patient groups, either from schools or via advertisement... Participants received MRI scans on the same 3-Tesla Siemens TIM Trio scanner with a 32-channel phased-array head coil.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The 626 TDCs were used to construct sex-specific normative age models for GFA of 45 major WM tracts. The clinical groups (schizophrenia, ADHD, ASD) were used to compute individual deviations from the norm and for between-group comparisons. No separate train/test split was reported for the normative model itself.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Individualized tract-deviation profiles comprised GFA Z-scores of each WM tract derived from the sex-specific normative age models, constructed from 626 TDCs (Male/Female: 376/250; age range 5-40, 20.16 +/- 8.5 yrs) [17]. A moving average approach was used to obtain the unbiased mean and variance estimates for the GFA metric in each age range.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative model was constructed using 626 typically developing controls (TDCs). The paper does not report a separate train/test split within the TDC cohort - the entire TDC sample appears to have been used to construct the normative model. The normative modeling approach was based on a moving average method, and the methodology was developed in a prior study [17] (Tung et al., 2021).

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age statistics are reported for the overall TDC sample (N=626). The mean was 20.16 years with SD of 8.5 years. The age range was explicitly stated as 5-40 years. No separate train/test split is reported, so train-phase statistics are not available.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex distribution is reported for the overall TDC sample: 376 males and 250 females out of 626 total. Percentages were calculated: male 376/626 = 60.1%, female 250/626 = 39.9%. No separate train/test split is reported, so train-phase sex statistics are not available.
